en_title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Re-Release With New Footage Sets December Release Date, Tickets on Sale This Week
cn_title: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》重映版定档12月，将加入新片段，本周开票
opus_summary: 漫威影业宣布，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》加长重映版将于2026年12月4日上映，包含新场景及其他惊喜，电影票11月19日开售。据Deadline报道，新片段预计包括罗莎里奥·道森饰演夜班护士的删减场景。

paragraphs.en: Marvel Studios has revealed the release date for its Spider-Man: Brand New Day re-release, promising to bring new footage "and a couple more surprises" to theaters this December.
paragraphs.cn: 漫威影业公布了《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》重映版的上映日期，并承诺今年12月将在影院带来新片段「以及另外几个惊喜」。

paragraphs.en: The official Spider-Man X/Twitter account confirmed plans to bring Peter Parker's (Tom Holland) first run-in with Jean Grey (Sadie Sink) back to moviegoers when the re-release arrives December 4, 2026. That means we're just a few weeks away from its premiere, with the full post teasing that this version of the movie is "an extended cut featuring new scenes and a couple more surprises."
paragraphs.cn: 蜘蛛侠官方X账号确认，计划在重映版于2026年12月4日上映时，让观众重温彼得·帕克（汤姆·赫兰德饰）与琴·葛蕾（萨迪·辛克饰）的首次交锋。这意味着距离影片上映只有几周时间，完整帖文还预告称，这个版本是「包含新场景和另外几个惊喜的加长版」。

paragraphs.en: Tickets go on sale this Thursday, November 19. Hope you're not busy!
paragraphs.cn: 电影票将于本周四，也就是11月19日开售。希望你到时有空！

paragraphs.en: As reported by Deadline earlier this year, Sony had plans to bring Spider-Man: Brand New Day back to theaters just months after the MCU movie's original premiere shattered records . Officially titled Spider-Man: Brand New Brand New Day, the outlet reported today that the plan is still for at least some of that new footage to include a cut scene featuring Rosario Dawson as her Defenders-era character, Night Nurse .
paragraphs.cn: 正如Deadline今年早些时候报道的那样，在这部漫威电影宇宙影片首次上映并打破纪录仅几个月后，索尼就计划让《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》重返影院。该媒体今天报道称，这个正式定名为《蜘蛛侠: Brand New Brand New Day》的版本仍计划在新增片段中至少加入一场被删减的戏，其中罗莎里奥·道森将饰演她在《捍卫者联盟》时期扮演的角色Night Nurse。

paragraphs.en: Even if you've had your fill of Holland's web-swinging antics for the year, Disney, Marvel, and Sony definitely know what they're doing when it comes to convincing MCU fans for a second round of their movies. Avengers: Doomsday will premiere just two weeks after Spidey returns. Although the December re-release may not be quite as likely to include any tie-in teaser footage like September's Avengers: Endgame Encore , Marvel fans will probably show up just to make sure, especially considering that "couple more surprises" tease.
paragraphs.cn: 即使你今年已经看够了赫兰德荡着蛛丝的各种表演，迪士尼、漫威和索尼在说服漫威电影宇宙粉丝二刷影片这件事上，肯定很清楚自己在做什么。《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》将在蜘蛛侠回归仅两周后上映。尽管12月的重映版或许不太可能像9月的《Avengers: Endgame Encore》那样包含任何联动预告片段，漫威粉丝可能还是会去看一场，以确认是否如此，尤其是考虑到「另外几个惊喜」的预告。

paragraphs.en: There's also the fact that the wait for Avengers: Doomsday has already been quite long. Marvel has refrained from saying or showing too much about the film's actual plot, making that early December window a nice opportunity to capitalize on the hype and move Spider-Man's box-office needle just a little more.
paragraphs.cn: 还有一个事实是，观众等待《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》已经相当久了。漫威一直没有透露或展示太多影片的实际剧情，这使得12月初成为一个不错的时机，可以利用这股热度，让《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的票房再涨一点。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day premiered July 31, 2026, and was immediately a box office hit. It finally arrived on digital October 6 after grossing more than $2.5 billion worldwide, securing its place as one of the highest-grossing movies of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》于2026年7月31日上映，并立即成为票房热门。影片在全球收获超过25亿美元票房后，最终于10月6日登陆数字平台，跻身影史票房最高的电影之列。

paragraphs.en: IGN gave it a 7/10 review . At the time, we said it "effectively refocuses on the most reliable pillars of the webslinger: battling inner turmoil, swinging around NYC saving the day, and looking cool while doing so.
paragraphs.cn: IGN在评测中为影片打出7/10分。当时，我们表示影片「有效地将焦点重新放在这位蛛丝英雄最可靠的几大支柱上：与内心的纷乱斗争、在纽约市荡来荡去拯救世界，以及在此过程中保持帅气。
